title: Machine Learning
summary: Teach a computer to learn from data: regression, classification, trees, clustering and how to tell if a model is any good.
outcomes: Explain what machine learning is and when to use it
Split data and train a model with scikit-learn
Measure a model honestly and avoid overfitting
Package a model so it can be reused
Engineer features safely and avoid data leakage
Diagnose and fix over- and underfitting with regularisation
Use gradient boosting, handle rare classes and reduce dimensions with PCA
Interpret models and validate time-series models honestly, and watch for drift
